meta.source: USPTO Open Data Portal; benchmarked to NAI Top 100 Universities

tier1.name: Patents & inventors
tier1.desc: U.S. utility patents assigned to Georgia Tech, and the inventors behind them.

tier1.name: Licensing & startups
tier1.desc: Invention disclosures, licenses & options executed, licensing income, and startups formed — on AUTM's national definitions.
tier1.metrics: Source: GT OTL + AUTM licensing survey

tier1.name: Federal innovation funding
tier1.desc: SBIR / STTR awards flowing to Georgia Tech startups and faculty-affiliated firms.
tier1.metrics: Source: SBIR.gov, matched to the spinout roster

tier1.name: Industry research engagement
tier1.desc: Industry-sponsored research expenditures and active corporate research agreements.
tier1.metrics: Source: GT research accounting + NSF HERD

tier2.name: Startup growth & retention
tier2.desc: Jobs and follow-on capital at Georgia Tech spinouts, exits, and the share that stay in Georgia — reported as activity at spinouts, never as GT-attributed totals.

tier3.name: Alumni entrepreneurship & knowledge diffusion
tier3.desc: Aggregate footprint of alumni-founded companies and the geographic spread of Georgia Tech knowledge, with an explicit attribution stance — after the MIT / Stanford model.
